title: 조용한 인사
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Ballad. A grand piano plays a rubato introduction before settling into a steady 4/4 rhythm. A male baritone vocal performs with a breathy, intimate delivery in the lower register, transitioning to a powerful, resonant chest voice in the higher register. A lush string section provides legato counter-melodies and sustained harmonic pads. An acoustic guitar enters with light strumming. The arrangement features a prominent orchestral swell. Key of E Major. Tempo is 72 BPM.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[rubato grand piano arpeggios]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals]
소파에서 일어나 [piano settles into 4/4 rhythm]
무릎이 소리를 내
처음 듣는 소리야
아닌 척 걸었어
거실에 햇살이 와 [strings enter with soft legato pads]
몸이 무거워
일요일 아침이 길어
발끝이 시려
아무도 안 봤으면

[Chorus]
[vocal intensity increases, strings swell]
예전 같지 않아
처음 꺼낸 말이야 [acoustic guitar enters with light strumming]
